prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Istanbul in a far-future cyberpunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: Istanbul two centuries from now, a far-future megacity on both shores of its strait: bridges of light spanning the water between Europe and Asia in several tiers, silent hydrofoil ferries and quiet flying vehicles crossing along glowing lanes; the seven hills of the old city kept exactly as they were, their domes and slender minarets glowing gold beneath a vast clear canopy; the round stone tower with its conical cap kept whole, ringed by a slow halo of light; on the Asian shore far-future towers of white ceramic and turquoise glass rising, their facades traced with glowing tulip and carnation patterns; the small white tower on its islet at the mouth of the strait sending a beam of light across the water, under a clear deep-indigo night sky.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
